oldmc.option.hideFallingLeaves.tooltip:
Choose which falling leaves to hide.
Before 1.21.5, only cherry and pale oak trees shed leaves.
In 1.21.5, oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, azalea, and flowering azalea leaves also gained falling leaf particles.

oldmc.option.versionFormat.tooltip:
Major update format uses Minecraft’s earlier numbering scheme for major updates. 26.1 becomes 1.22, 26.1.x becomes 1.22.x, and 26.2 becomes 1.23.
With the year-based update format, 26.1 becomes 1.26, 26.1.1 becomes 1.26.1, 26.1.2 becomes 1.26.2, 26.2 becomes 1.26.3, and so on.
With the 1.21.x format, 26.1 appears as 1.21.12. Each subsequent update or hotfix increases the last number by one.
Requires “Classic version numbers”.
